tagline.zh-CN: 住在你手机里的 3D 试衣间
tagline.en: A 3D fitting room that lives on your phone

description.zh-CN: 穿好衣把你的身材和你真实的衣服重建成可以转着看的 3D：捏出自己的身形与五官，拍一张衣服照片就能穿到身上，外套、上衣、裙子自由叠穿。重建、渲染、换装全部在手机本地完成，衣柜和身材数据不上传。
description.en: DressWell rebuilds your body and your real clothes as 3D you can spin: shape your own figure and face, photograph a garment to wear it, and layer coats, tops and dresses freely. Reconstruction, rendering and styling all run on the phone — your wardrobe and body data never leave the device.

name.zh-CN: 真 3D：转着看，不是等一张图
name.en: Real 3D you can spin, not a rendered picture

summary.zh-CN: 实时 3D 试衣间：转身看背面、拉近看袖口，衣服之间的遮挡是几何算出来的。
summary.en: A real-time 3D fitting room: turn to see the back, zoom into a cuff. Garment occlusion is computed geometry, not a guess.

detail.zh-CN: 照片生成类产品给你的是一张静态图，换个角度要重新生成一次，叠穿时外套里面那条裙子长什么样只能靠模型自由发挥。穿好衣用的是设备上的实时 3D 渲染（Google Filament），外套、上衣、下装、袜子、鞋、帽子各占一个槽位，谁塞进谁、哪块面被挡住都是逐顶点算出来的，所以任意角度、任意组合都一致。
detail.en: Photo-generation apps hand you one static image; a different angle means generating again, and when you layer, the dress under the coat is whatever the model imagines. DressWell renders in real time on the device (Google Filament). Coats, tops, bottoms, socks, shoes and hats each own a slot, and which garment tucks under which — plus every hidden face — is computed per vertex, so any angle and any combination stay consistent.

name.zh-CN: 真身材：告诉你合不合身，而不是把你 P 好看
name.en: Your real proportions, not a flattering edit

summary.zh-CN: 身高、体型、五官是参数化人体，捏成你自己；衣服贴合靠几何计算。
summary.en: Height, body shape and facial features are a parametric human you shape yourself; garment fit is geometry.

detail.zh-CN: 常见的照片生成路线有个老毛病：把人画瘦、画高、画标准，好看但不诚实，买回来不合身还是你的问题。穿好衣的形象是参数化人体，身高、肩宽、腰臀、十余项面部微调都在你手里；衣服是网格贴合而不是重绘，所以它不奉承你，它告诉你真的合不合适。也可以用一张照片让模型更接近你，那一步给的是可以继续拖的初值，不是不可修改的结果。
detail.en: The usual photo-generation route has a familiar flaw: it makes you slimmer, taller, more standard — flattering, but not honest, and the garment still does not fit when it arrives. DressWell's avatar is a parametric human: height, shoulders, waist and hips, plus a dozen facial dials, all under your control. Clothes are fitted meshes rather than repaints, so the app does not flatter you — it tells you whether something actually fits. A photo can bring the avatar closer to you, and what it produces are starting values you can keep adjusting, not a fixed result.

name.zh-CN: 拍一张，你的衣服进 3D 衣柜
name.en: Photograph a garment, and it joins your 3D wardrobe

summary.zh-CN: 平铺拍一张真实衣服，去底、还原颜色与花纹，前后投影到 3D 身上。
summary.en: Lay a real garment flat, take one photo: background removed, colour and pattern recovered, projected front and back.

detail.zh-CN: 整条链路都在设备上跑：去掉背景、压掉褶皱的明暗、白平衡校正、按肩肘袖口三点把布料映射到袖子上。电商平台那种正面平铺、纯色背景、没人穿着的标准商品图重建效果最好。做出来的衣服和内置款式一样可以叠穿、可以存进造型。
detail.en: The whole pipeline runs on the device: background removal, flattening the shading of wrinkles, white-balance correction, and mapping fabric along a shoulder-elbow-cuff path so sleeves follow a bent arm. Standard online-shop product shots — front-on, plain background, nobody wearing it — reconstruct best. The result layers and saves exactly like a built-in garment.

name.zh-CN: 真隐私：没有服务器，没有账号

summary.zh-CN: 无云后端。重建、渲染、换装全在本机，衣柜和身材数据不上传。
summary.en: No cloud backend. Reconstruction, rendering and styling all happen locally; wardrobe and body data are never uploaded.

detail.zh-CN: 不需要注册，没有埋点，没有广告。形象、造型存档和你上传的衣服都存在应用自己的沙盒里，可选备份进你本人的 iCloud 私有容器。唯一会离开设备的情况是你自己配置了大模型服务：那时照片直接发往你填的那个服务商地址，我们不持有 Key、不做中转，所以那些请求我们也看不到。不配置的话整个应用照常可用，所有 AI 路径退回手动。
detail.en: No sign-up, no analytics, no ads. Your avatar, saved looks and uploaded garments live in the app's own sandbox, with optional backup into your personal iCloud container. The only case where anything leaves the device is if you configure your own model provider: the photo then goes straight to the endpoint you entered. We hold no key and proxy nothing, so we cannot see those requests either. Without a key the app works fully and every AI path falls back to manual input.

name.en: Scan your own bag into 3D (iPhone Pro)

summary.zh-CN: 带激光雷达的 iPhone 环绕拍摄小物，端上重建，挂到形象手上或头上。
summary.en: Circle a small object with a LiDAR iPhone, rebuild it on device, then hang it on the avatar's hand or head.

detail.zh-CN: 用 Apple 的 Object Capture 在设备上重建，不上传照片。重建出来的包按手骨挂载，帽子按头骨挂载并自动藏掉被盖住的头发和头皮。这是「数字衣柜」走向「数字分身」的最后一公里，也是照片生成类产品没有对应物的一块。安卓端不做扫描（缺同等的端上重建能力）。
detail.en: Rebuilt on device with Apple's Object Capture; no photos are uploaded. A finished bag mounts to the hand joint, a hat to the head joint, with the hair and scalp it covers hidden automatically. This is the last mile from a digital wardrobe to a digital double, and it has no counterpart in photo-generation apps. Scanning is iOS-only, since Android lacks an equivalent on-device pipeline.

name.zh-CN: 搭配师跑在你自己的 Key 上
name.en: A stylist that runs on your own API key

summary.zh-CN: 可选的 AI 搭配建议：你的服务商、你的账单，我们不转卖推理。
summary.en: Optional AI styling advice: your provider, your bill. We do not resell inference.

detail.zh-CN: 在设置里填自己的大模型 Key（预置了九家常见服务商的地址和模型名），搭配师就能按场合、身形和你真实的衣橱给建议，并且记得你的偏好。它只推荐你实际拥有的单品。技能包是打包好的提示词模板，卖的不是 AI 额度。不填 Key 也能用整个试衣间。
detail.en: Enter your own model key in Settings — nine common providers come pre-filled with endpoints and model names — and the stylist suggests outfits by occasion, body shape and the wardrobe you actually own, remembering your preferences. It only recommends pieces you have. Skill packs are bundled prompt templates, not AI credit. Without a key the whole fitting room still works.

a.zh-CN: 一个装在手机里的 3D 试衣间。你先捏出接近自己的 3D 形象（身高、体型、五官、肤色、发型），然后用内置款式或者拍照上传自己的真实衣服来搭配，可以 360 度转着看。重建、渲染和换装都在手机本地完成，不需要注册账号。
a.en: A 3D fitting room on your phone. You shape an avatar close to yourself — height, body, face, skin tone, hair — then style it with built-in garments or your own real clothes photographed into the app, and view it from any angle. Reconstruction, rendering and styling all run locally, and no account is required.

q.zh-CN: 我的照片和身材数据会上传吗？
q.en: Are my photos and body measurements uploaded?

a.zh-CN: 默认不会。穿好衣没有服务器，也没有账号系统：形象、造型存档和你上传的衣服都在应用自己的沙盒里，可以选择备份进你本人的 iCloud 私有容器。唯一的例外是你主动在设置里配置了自己的大模型服务，此时照片会直接发往你填写的那个服务商地址，按对方的留存策略处理。我们不持有你的 Key、不做中转，因此也看不到这些请求。
a.en: Not by default. DressWell has no servers and no account system: your avatar, saved looks and uploaded garments live in the app's own sandbox, with optional backup into your personal iCloud container. The one exception is if you deliberately configure your own model provider in Settings — the photo then goes directly to the endpoint you entered and is handled under that provider's retention policy. We never hold your key and never proxy the request, so we cannot see it either.

a.zh-CN: 能。试衣间、内置衣物、捏脸捏体型、拍照上传自己的衣服都是本机计算，飞行模式下照常工作。只有可选的 AI 搭配建议需要联网，因为那一步要访问你自己配置的模型服务。
a.en: Yes. The fitting room, built-in garments, face and body shaping, and photographing your own clothes are all local computation and work in airplane mode. Only the optional AI styling advice needs a connection, because that step calls the model provider you configured yourself.

a.zh-CN: 免费下载，可以完整试用：内置衣物、发型、帽子全部开放，形体和五官不限次调整，换装有 20 次免费额度，造型存档 2 套。Pro 是一次性买断、永久有效，解锁不限次换装、无限存档和拍照上传自己的衣服。搭配师的付费技能包单独计价，不含在 Pro 里。没有订阅，没有广告。
a.en: Free to download and genuinely usable: all built-in garments, hairstyles and hats are open, body and face shaping are unlimited, outfit changes come with a free allowance of 20, and you can keep 2 saved looks. Pro is a one-time purchase that lasts forever and unlocks unlimited outfit changes, unlimited saved looks, and photographing your own clothes. The stylist's paid skill packs are priced separately and are not included in Pro. No subscription, no ads.

q.zh-CN: AI 搭配师需要我自己出 Key 吗？
q.en: Do I have to supply my own API key for the stylist?

a.zh-CN: 是的，这是有意的设计。你在设置里填自己的大模型服务（预置了九家常见服务商的地址和模型名），请求直连那家服务商，账单也记在你自己名下。这样我们既不经手你的照片，也不需要把推理成本折进订阅里。不配置 Key 的话应用照常可用，所有需要 AI 的地方都退回手动操作。
a.en: Yes, and that is deliberate. You enter your own model provider in Settings — nine common ones come pre-filled — the request goes straight to that provider, and the bill is yours. That way we neither handle your photos nor need to fold inference costs into a subscription. Without a key the app still works, and everywhere AI would help falls back to doing it by hand.

a.zh-CN: iOS 和 Android。3D 渲染用的是 Google Filament，对显卡有一定要求，太旧的机型帧率会低。用激光雷达扫描实物只在带 LiDAR 的 iPhone Pro / Pro Max 上提供，安卓端不做这一项。
a.en: iOS and Android. 3D rendering uses Google Filament and does ask something of the GPU, so frame rates drop on older phones. Scanning real objects with LiDAR is available only on iPhone Pro / Pro Max models that have it; Android does not offer that feature.

q.zh-CN: 换手机了，数据怎么带走？
q.en: How do I move my data to a new phone?

a.zh-CN: iOS 上可以开启 iCloud 备份，形象和自定义衣服会同步进你自己的 iCloud 私有容器，新机装上应用后恢复即可。买过 Pro 的话在付费页点「恢复购买」，用同一个商店账号就能拿回权益，不会重复扣款。
a.en: On iOS you can turn on iCloud backup; your avatar and custom garments sync into your own private iCloud container, and you restore them after installing the app on the new phone. If you bought Pro, tap Restore purchase on the paywall and sign in with the same store account — the entitlement comes back and you are not charged twice.

q.en: How do I delete my data?

a.zh-CN: 设置里的隐私页可以逐项删除：形象存档、上传的衣服、用于捏形象的那张照片。删除是立即生效的本地删除。卸载应用会一并清掉沙盒里的全部内容。开过 iCloud 备份的话，还要在系统的 iCloud 设置里删掉对应的应用数据。
a.en: The privacy page in Settings lets you delete each item: saved looks, uploaded garments, and the photo used to shape the avatar. Deletion is local and immediate. Uninstalling the app removes everything in its sandbox. If you enabled iCloud backup, also remove the app's data in your system iCloud settings.
